How to install:

1. Install [Raspberry Pi Imager](https://www.raspberrypi.com/software/).
2. Click a `.rpi-imager-manifest` link in the "Assets" section below!

<details>
<summary>How to use Raspberry Pi Imager</summary>

1. Click the `.rpi-imager-manifest` link in the "Assets" section, it downloads the file. Double click to open in rpi-imager. If nothing happens try right-clicking the downloaded file and select "Open With: Raspberry Pi Imager"

<img width="746" height="143" alt="Image" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiab/iiab/master/.github/assets/rpi-imager-step1-open-manifest.png" />

2. Select any device to continue

<img width="675" height="477" alt="Image" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiab/iiab/master/.github/assets/rpi-imager-step2-select-device.png" />

3. Select the Internet in a Box "OS" to move forward

<img width="678" height="480" alt="Image" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiab/iiab/master/.github/assets/rpi-imager-step3-select-os.png" />

4. Select the `Storage` media that you are writing to. rpi-imager will only let you select removable storage but you should still double check here so that you don't accidently lose all your data stored in the "wrong" storage media.

<img width="677" height="474" alt="Image" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiab/iiab/master/.github/assets/rpi-imager-step4-select-storage.png" />

5. Don't click `SKIP CUSTOMISATION`. Click Next. Set your username and password to be able to login to IIAB Admin Console. Enable SSH if you would like to login to the IIAB via Secure Shell later otherwise leave SSH disabled.

<img width="670" height="471" alt="Image" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiab/iiab/master/.github/assets/rpi-imager-step5-customise.png" />

</details>
